verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile the Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, cost, CaC availability, and mechanics. Preserve unresolved stamina, probability, and Ultimate Finish conditions as null.
research_scope: Meteor Blow — Strike Super acquisition and mechanics research.

verification_audit.method: Compared the repository's available Strike Super research coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Dragon Ball documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Meteor Blow was found in the available research corpus. The canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Meteor Blow as a Strike Super Attack.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation lists Parallel Quest 09 — The Saiyan King Is...Who? as an acquisition route and also identifies it as a possible starting skill when choosing the close-up fighting style.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the reviewed documentation does not establish an Ultimate Finish as mandatory for the documented PQ09/start-selection routes.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because the reviewed canonical sources do not establish a reliable stamina value.

records.name: Meteor Blow
records.character_source: Goku / Gohan (Kid) / Gohan (Adult) / other documented customizable partners
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest reward / starting skill selection
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 09 — The Saiyan King Is...Who? / close-up fighting-style starting selection
records.skill_description: A two-hit launching Strike Super that kicks the opponent upward, teleports into position, and follows with a finishing kick that sends the opponent away.
records.mechanics_notes: The first kick launches the opponent; the user then teleports into the opponent's path for the finishing kick. The opening attack can be confirmed by Ki-based hit interaction, enabling the teleport follow-through. The move is useful for setting up follow-up attacks after its knockback. Exact frame and damage values are not promoted to canonical data.
records.acquisition_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference lists PQ09 as an acquisition route and also documents Meteor Blow as a starting skill when the close-up fighting style is selected. These routes are preserved together rather than collapsing them into an unsupported single unlock condition.
records.pve_notes: PQ09 and starting-selection acquisition routes documented; no mandatory Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Fast launching kick with teleport follow-through and combo/knockback utility; detailed frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
